Scribe is a desktop LaTeX editor designed for scientists, integrating LaTeX papers with Python notebooks and figures into a single project. It allows for seamless compilation of documents on the user's machine using Tectonic or TeX Live, ensuring privacy and local control.

✅ Support for English and Russian languages

✅ Local Wi-Fi control
✅ Pointer support via native TV provider or Android Bluetooth HID

OpenTV-Remote is a free, open-source mobile application for Android and iPhone that functions as a smart TV remote. It offers custom layouts, local Wi-Fi control, and supports English and Russian languages, with a focus on providing a seamless and user-friendly remote experience without requiring subscriptions or accounts.
